name: Prashant India Ltd.
summary: Prashant India Ltd. operates across multiple sectors, encompassing the production, distribution, and international trade of agricultural commodities and textile products, in addition to generating wind power. The company also maintains dedicated manufacturing facilities for yarn processing, including sizing, texturizing, and twisting. Its business operations are primarily structured into two key segments: Textile and Wind Farm. Established on November 23, 1983, Prashant India Ltd. is headquartered in Palsana, India.
